answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have profoundly revolutionized the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP) ... To improve LLMs' inference performance on complex inference tasks, it is popular to adopt a stepby-step reasoning framework known as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include step-by-step reasoning traces and final answers to complex reasoning questions across mathematical, symbolic, and commonsense domains.

answer_2.quote: We test Zero-Shot CoT and Nash CoT with the core LLM includes Mistral-Instruct (7B) and GLM4-chat (9B) on mathematical benchmarks including AddSub, MultiArith, SingleEQ, SVAMP, GSM8K, and AQuA. Nash CoT performs the best.
